description:
## Problem

`HtmlExtractor#parse_validated_url` (lines 72–82) combines three concerns:

1. `UrlProcessor.sanitize_feed_url(site_url)` — strip feed suffix
2. `UrlValidator.valid_url?(clean_url)` — scheme + host validation
3. `URI.parse(clean_url)` — actual parsing

This is a composed operation that other callers may need. Putting it inside HtmlExtractor violates single responsibility and makes the validation logic invisible to other consumers.

## Proposed Fix

Add a new class method to `UrlProcessor`:

```crystal
def self.parse_and_validate(url : String) : URI?
  clean = sanitize_feed_url(url)
  return nil unless UrlValidator.valid_url?(clean)
  parsed = URI.parse(clean)
  return nil unless parsed.scheme
  parsed
rescue URI::Error
  nil
end
```

Then simplify HtmlExtractor to:

```crystal
private def parse_validated_url(site_url : String) : URI?
  UrlProcessor.parse_and_validate(site_url) || debug_return("URL validation failed: #{site_url}")
end
```

## Files
- src/vug/url_processor.cr (add parse_and_validate)
- src/vug/html_extractor.cr (simplify parse_validated_url)
- spec/vug/url_processor_spec.cr (add tests for parse_and_validate)
title: Extract composed URL validation from HtmlExtractor into UrlProcessor
